meta.note: Manual catalogue, seeded from the GitHub API. To add a project: copy an entry, set slug/title/blurb/collection/updated. url and repo are derived from the slug unless overridden.

collections.name: Decision & Crisis
collections.blurb: Take a seat you can't delegate and steer under hard constraints.

collections.name: Forecasting & Estimation
collections.blurb: Reason under uncertainty — decompose, calibrate, and judge precision.

collections.name: Habit & Behaviour
collections.blurb: The mechanics of automaticity, friction, and reward.

collections.name: Judgement & Leadership
collections.blurb: Hold your stated values up against how you actually act.

collections.name: Personal & Utilities
collections.blurb: Smaller tools built for a specific person or purpose.

projects.title: The Turnaround Board
projects.blurb: Take over a failing 84-store retailer as its crisis chief executive and reach solvency across twelve weeks of unforgiving weekly trade-offs.

projects.title: Outbreak
projects.blurb: Direct a city's response to a novel pathogen as Emergency Public Health Director, making binding weekly policy and budget decisions over twelve weeks.

projects.title: Founder's Dilemma
projects.blurb: Negotiate three venture funding rounds and an exit, discovering how term sheets and the payout waterfall decide what you personally bank.

projects.title: PEP Simulation
projects.blurb: Hold a fragile US–Iran ceasefire together through a chain of crisis decisions — built for the Hult Ignite lecture series.

projects.title: The Meridian Gazette
projects.blurb: Take the editor's chair at a struggling regional daily and balance circulation, ethics, and a tighter-than-promised budget in daily calls.

projects.title: Forecasting Pedagogy Simulations
projects.blurb: A hub of three self-contained classroom exercises — Fermi Forge, Belief Lab, and the Fox & Hedgehog Derby — with seeded, reproducible runs.

projects.title: Fermi Forge
projects.blurb: Learn Fermi estimation by decomposing impossible questions into tractable ones, from London's boiler engineers to Fermi's Trinity paper-drop.

projects.title: Fox & Hedgehog Derby
projects.blurb: Forecast twelve questions about a fictional region against Fox and Hedgehog bots, testing Tetlock's finding that cognitive style predicts accuracy.

projects.title: The Briefing Room
projects.blurb: Carry analysts' probability estimates to the President and learn when numeric precision is real signal and when it is merely decoration.

projects.title: Friction Wars
projects.blurb: Engineer the path of least resistance: spend a friction budget so the good habit becomes the easy one, in a head-to-head design game.

projects.title: Rituals & Rhythms
projects.blurb: Trace how the body clock's master pacemaker and its hormonal cascades make behaviours feel automatic, through a guided circadian-biology scenario.

projects.title: Habit-Strength Accumulator
projects.blurb: Watch automaticity build along a realistic asymptotic curve and see how long a new habit actually takes to plateau, anchored to Lally et al. (2010).

projects.title: Demand Selection
projects.blurb: A repeated free-choice task exploring how we drift toward familiar, lower-effort options over many small decisions.

projects.title: Reward-Prediction-Error Visualiser
projects.blurb: An interactive instrument showing how the dopamine surprise signal migrates from reward to predictive cue as learning takes hold.

projects.title: The Leadership Mirror
projects.blurb: A two-stage assessment testing whether the leadership values you state stay consistent with each other — and with how you act under pressure.

projects.title: The Leadership Mirror — Judgement Edition
projects.blurb: Maps where your leadership beliefs sit across contested value trade-offs and how consistently you hold them. (A variant of The Leadership Mirror.)

projects.title: Sarah's Gym Tracker
projects.blurb: A personal web app for logging and tracking gym workouts and progress over time.
